events.summary: Speaker A stated the remote must be original and trendy, and user-friendly.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Uh first of all uh it must be original, uh and trendy

events.summary: Speaker A set three design stages: functional, conceptual and detailed, each with individual work and a meeting.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: There are three stages. There is a functional design

events.summary: Speaker A stated the selling price for the remote will be twenty-five euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the selling price for the remote will be uh twenty five Euro

events.summary: Speaker A said the production cost may not be more than twenty and a half euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: may not be more than uh twenty and a half Euro

events.summary: Speaker A also said the remote must come in at about twelve euros fifty, so it cannot be very high tech.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: for twelve uh fift uh twelve and a half Euro

events.summary: Speaker A stated the profit the new remote must make is fifty million euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the profit we must make with uh the new remote is uh fifty million Euro

events.summary: Speaker A calculated that at twenty-five euros about two million remotes must be sold, across the international market.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: when the selling price is twenty five, uh uh you got two million, two million remotes

events.summary: Speaker B said the most important function is switching channels, and the remote should be kept as basic as possible.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: I think the most important thing of a remote control is that you can switch channels

events.summary: Speaker D listed marketing requirements: intuitive, small and fairly cheap, at about twenty-five euros.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: things like uh intuitive, uh small, fairly cheap

events.summary: Speaker D proposed the remote should work regardless of the TV brand.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: it doesn't have to matter uh which brand your T_V_ or other thing is

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a multi-purpose remote, since most remotes only serve one purpose and this would be a new feature.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: I personally think it has to be multi-purpose

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a technology other than infrared, such as radio or Bluetooth, since infrared fails when someone stands in front of the TV.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: maybe some other technology than infrared

events.summary: Speaker D said radio or Bluetooth might be a little expensive.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: That might be a little bit uh expensive

events.summary: Speaker D proposed an LCD screen that shows upcoming programmes while the user watches a channel.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: when you're on a certain channel, you can see on the L_C_D_ screen

events.summary: Speaker A said the remote must be really innovative and technically advanced.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: it must be really uh innovative, technical-wise

events.summary: Speaker A proposed focusing on things that really add something to the current market.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we must focus on things who are really uh really add something

events.summary: Speaker D said a new entrant needs to do something special to gain market share.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: you have to do something special, I think

events.summary: Speaker A objected that early ideas should not lose sight of user-friendliness.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we must not uh lose uh sight of the the user uh uh friendly

events.summary: Speaker A assigned the Industrial Designer, Speaker C, to look at the working design before the next meeting.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the Industrial uh Designer has to uh look at the working design

events.summary: Speaker A assigned the User Interface Designer, Speaker B, to look at the technical functions before the next meeting.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the User Interface Designer has to look at the technical functions

events.summary: Speaker C proposed deferring whether the remote serves multiple systems to the next meeting, and Speaker D agreed.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: I figure we could get back to it on the next meeting actually

events.summary: Speaker D proposed making mock-ups and general ideas first, before planning further.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: make some mock-ups, some some general ideas
